latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Best Video Editor AI.
- Instantly edit and export polished 1080p MP4 videos from raw footage (up to 500MB; MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM).
- Just describe your editing needs (e.g., "cut dead air, add transitions")—no complex software required.
- Cloud-based editing with fast turnaround (about 1–2 minutes for short clips).
- Supports key editing workflows: quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement.
- Live status updates, session handling, and credit management included.
